name: Claire - Salad Dressing Sugar V3
master_prompt: Fast native American TikTok UGC with the same Claire identity and female voice. Create a concrete supermarket-label reveal and simple food demonstration. No fake brands, cure claims, baked captions, or impossible food motion.

hooks.title: Dessert hiding on salad
hooks.script: Your salad can turn into dessert before you take the first bite.
hooks.prompt: Dramatic but believable kitchen selfie. Claire holds a healthy salad in one hand and pours an excessive stream from a generic dressing bottle with the other, then freezes with a shocked expression. Correct two-hand anatomy, no extra limbs, no brand. Native dialogue exactly once: Your salad can turn into dessert before you take the first bite.

segments.script: Words like light and natural make people stop at the front label.
segments.prompt: Claire holds a generic unbranded salad-dressing bottle toward the phone, taps its intentionally non-legible front label, and gives a skeptical look. Native dialogue exactly once: Words like light and natural make people stop at the front label.

segments.script: But the serving is smaller than the amount most people actually pour.
segments.prompt: Top-down real kitchen shot comparing a measured spoon of dressing with a much larger casual pour over salad. Natural liquid flow and hands, no floating objects. Native dialogue exactly once: But the serving is smaller than the amount most people actually pour.

segments.script: Turn it around and check added sugar before the health words distract you.
segments.prompt: Close handheld shot of Claire turning a generic bottle to a deliberately soft, unreadable nutrition panel while pointing to the added-sugar area. Native dialogue exactly once: Turn it around and check added sugar before the health words distract you.

segments.script: My backup is olive oil, lemon, mustard, salt, and one fast shake.
segments.prompt: Medium kitchen-counter shot. Claire adds olive oil, lemon juice, a small spoon of mustard and a pinch of salt to a glass jar, closes it, then gives one quick shake. Real ingredients and physics. Native dialogue exactly once: My backup is olive oil, lemon, mustard, salt, and one fast shake.

ctas.title: Comment DRESSING
ctas.script: Comment DRESSING and I will send you the five-second formula.
ctas.prompt: Claire holds the sealed dressing jar and finished salad toward the camera, direct eye contact, same kitchen and outfit. Native dialogue exactly once: Comment DRESSING and I will send you the five-second formula.
